hypothesis: Train the current-price-to-30s-endpoint direction directly instead of treating short structural reactions as equivalent to a 30s endpoint prediction.
training: Nine previously inspected official Binance spot windows for BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT and SOLUSDT, 2025-10-15 through 2025-10-17. Use the existing 100-minute warmup plus evaluation data. Sample every 30 source seconds only when 180 seconds of contiguous past observations and a completed 30s label exist. Ties excluded. No native user video or OTC observations in training.
model: One logistic regression, L2 regularization C=0.1, no intercept, solver lbfgs, max_iter=2000. Mirror signed features/labels to enforce price-direction symmetry. Scale by training RMS only. Exactly the named features in expiry-endpoint-features-20261019.mjs; no search over thresholds or hyperparameters.
developmentScreen: Original issued entries in the existing known Forex set and the nine known crypto windows dated 2025-10-18 through 2025-10-20. Compare exact same entry time, price and 30s deadline. Preserve original side if features unavailable. Require higher aggregate win rate, positive illustrative net at 86% payout and no worse worst-window loss streak in EACH dataset. If this fails, reject before full replay or new holdout.
integration: If development passes, replay the complete runtime with this one final direction owner for 30s, before the immutable entry lifecycle, without changing admission. Do not touch production, the bot, balance, broker controls or other durations during research.
untouchedValidation: Only if the full development replay passes unchanged: official Binance BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT/SOLUSDT 1s observations, 2025-10-24, 25 and 26, 15:00-15:30 UTC. No tuning after these results. The separately registered October 21-23 set remains untouched.
limitations: External spot and historical Forex are not broker OTC executions. All development data have been inspected. A small positive backtest cannot establish live accuracy or justify a promised win rate. No martingale, loss-triggered inversion or actual order.
